node_definition.done_when: Context: every benchmark, script and test that set the process-global support clip mode now passes an explicit mode (merged through 74d4cd1f3). The global survives only in its own home and in four tests. This node deletes it. (1) nova/equilibrium/forward_operator.py: remove _SUPPORT_CLIP_MODE, set_support_clip_mode and support_clip_mode. ForwardFluxOperator.clip_mode defaults to "chord", not None, and _active_support_clip_mode returns self.clip_mode with no fallback. Update every docstring that mentions the global to describe the request and operator mode. (2) nova/equilibrium/solve_request.py: remove _process_support_clip_mode, the bridge that let an omitted mode follow the global. ForwardSolveRequest.clip_mode, from_defaults and ResolvedForwardSolveDefaults.from_policy default to "chord", so an omitted mode is the production default and an explicit mode still wins. (3) Tests: tests/test_forward_support_clip_mode.py becomes tests of operator-level modes: chord is the default, and exact and chord_cells apply through with_clip_mode; drop anything that only exercised the setter. tests/test_forward_solve_clip_mode_bridge.py asserts that an omitted request mode is chord on every construction route and that an explicit mode wins, with no global. tests/test_forward_solve_clip_mode_request.py and tests/test_transport_forward_seam.py use explicit modes in place of any global set. (4) A new tests/test_clip_mode_has_no_process_global.py scans nova/, benchmarks/, scripts/ and tests/ with ast or tokenize and fails naming any file that references set_support_clip_mode, support_clip_mode or _SUPPORT_CLIP_MODE, excluding its own source. Gate, logged under the run directory: the four test files above, the new file, tests/test_equilibrium_forward_operator.py, tests/test_forward_moment_class.py, tests/test_route_solve_requests.py and tests/test_forward_receipt_raster.py, run with JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu in one fresh pytest process per file in place on this fleet allocation, add no failure by test id against the dispatch base, recorded as baseline_suite and after_suite JSON objects with literal commands. Chord is the production default before and after, so chord results must be unchanged. Every uv command carries --no-sync and nothing runs uv sync. The manifest's status is one of complete, blocked or failed.
